geofenceListDescription: Boundaries you test reported positions against
geofenceRemoveConfirm: Delete geofence “{{token}}”? This cannot be undone.
geofenceTokenFixed: The geofence id; it cannot change.
geofenceMapLabel: Geofence boundary map. Click the map to add a corner; click the first corner to close the shape. Drag a corner to move it, Alt-click a corner to remove it, and click a small handle on an edge to add a corner there.
geofenceNoTilesHint: No tile provider is set, so this is the built-in world map: continents and borders only, with no detail as you zoom in. Drawing still works and the coordinates you place are exact. Set a tile URL below to see real map imagery.
geofenceMapUnavailable: The map could not be loaded, so the boundary cannot be drawn here. Reload the page to try again.
geofenceClosedHint: Shape closed. Drag a corner to move it, or undo a corner to keep drawing.
geofenceEditHint: Drag a corner to move it · Alt-click a corner to remove it · Click a handle on an edge to add a corner
geofenceErrTooFewVertices: A boundary needs at least three corners.
geofenceErrTooManyPositions: This boundary has {{count}} corners; the limit is {{max}}.
geofenceErrCoordinateRange: A corner falls outside the valid range of coordinates.
geofenceErrRepeatedVertex: Two corners sit in the same place. Undo the last one, or place it somewhere else.
geofenceErrSelfIntersecting: The boundary crosses itself. A shape with crossing edges has no clear inside, so it cannot be used as a fence — move a corner so the edges do not overlap.
geofenceTileUrlHelp: Remembered in this browser only — it is not shared with other users and is not stored on the server.
geofenceTileAttributionHelp: The credit line your tile provider requires you to display.
geofenceUnreadableGeometry: This geofence uses a shape this editor cannot draw. It is stored intact and is still enforced — only editing it here is unavailable. Leave it as it is rather than recreating it.
geofenceHistoryNone: No fence set has been recorded yet. One is frozen every time a geofence is created, changed or deleted.
geofenceHistoryVersionHelp: A version is frozen every time any geofence changes. Location events carry the version in force when they arrived, so a rule replayed over them is judged against the shapes below. Latest is {{latest}}.
geofenceHistoryAbsent: This geofence was not in the set at version {{version}}. It was created later, or a fence with this token was deleted and the token reused.
geofenceHistoryUnreadable: This geofence was in the set, but its shape is one this viewer cannot draw. It was still enforced.
geofenceHistoryLegend: Solid: the shape stored under this token at version {{version}}. Dashed: the shape now.
